217020.postText: Salute from all the Panthers players for the two batsmen, wonderful partnership after they lost 3 wickets in the first over. Fire crackers going off. Hugs from the players. This is a special win for the Panthers. Siechem Madurai Panthers win by 7 wickets and are the winners of the 2018 TNPL. Thanks for tuning in, it has been a pleasure bringing you the live ball by ball coverage of the TNPL. Do join us again for more tournaments.
